team.name: Job Search
team.description: Five agents for finding roles, tailoring applications, tracking outcomes, and interview prep.

members.name: Scout
members.title: Job finder
members.description: Finds and ranks job postings via portal CLIs. Can drive semi-automated apply with your approval at Submit.

members.name: Tailor
members.title: Application tailor
members.description: Paste a job description — fit evaluation, tailored CV and cover letter, PDF compile, ATS verification.

members.name: Tracker
members.title: Application tracker
members.description: Answers questions about your pipeline, logs outcomes, surfaces stale applications for follow-up.

members.name: Coach
members.title: Interview and profile coach
members.description: Interview prep, mock roleplay, LinkedIn suggestions, and skill-gap analysis.

members.name: Generalist
members.title: General job assistant
members.description: Anything else job-related — open-ended help across your job-search workspace.

room.name: Job Search
room.bulletin: Shared job-search workspace. Scout finds and ranks roles; Tailor tailors applications; Tracker logs pipeline; Coach preps interviews; Generalist handles ad hoc tasks. Never auto-submit applications — user approves Submit. All bots share the project folder.
